verdict.rationale: Smooth is driven programmatically through an SDK (a task runs in a few lines of code) and REST endpoints, so automation does not depend on an interactive UI. The API covers starting tasks, listing and cancelling them, polling for status, and returning structured outputs for deterministic downstream code. The CLI is documented to work with any agent that can run CLI commands. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples (e.g., GitHub Actions, env-var auth setup for pipelines), independent hands-on corroboration of unattended CI use.
